title: Daily Devotional #62
paragraphs: As I read Luke 18, I am struck by the message of persistent faith. In this chapter, we see examples of people who come to You with persistence and humility, and are rewarded for their faith.

The parable of the persistent widow is a powerful example of this. She keeps coming to the judge, asking for justice against her adversary, and though he initially refuses, eventually he grants her request because of her persistence. This reminds me that when I come to You with persistence and faith, You will hear my prayers and grant me what I need.

I also see the story of the Pharisee and the tax collector. The Pharisee boasts about his righteousness, while the tax collector humbly asks for mercy. You tell us that it was the tax collector who went home justified, because he recognized his own sin and came to You with humility. This reminds me that when I come to You with a humble heart, confessing my sins and asking for Your mercy, You will forgive me and restore me.

Finally, I see the story of the blind man who calls out to You as You pass by. Despite the crowd trying to silence him, he persists in calling out for Your help, and You heal him. This reminds me that when I come to You with persistence and faith, You have the power to heal me and transform my life.

Lord, help me to have the faith and persistence of these examples in Luke 18. May I come to You with humility, confessing my sins and asking for Your mercy. And may I persist in seeking Your help and guidance, trusting in Your power to transform my life.
